tool.name: Citation formatter
tool.description: Format citations and add or edit citation sources
tool.editorUnavailable: No editable source text is available.
lookup.sourceDescription: Enter a URL, identifier, or reference name.
lookup.sourceHelpText: Enter a URL, archive link, identifier (DOI, ISBN, ISSN, PMID, PMCID, or QID), or citation text. If the source already exists, a reference is inserted directly into the article source.
lookup.manualDescription: Create a blank source or use an existing citation as a starting point.
lookup.chooseBasedOn: Choose an existing citation to use as the starting point.
lookup.sourceRequired: Enter a source URL, identifier, or citation.
lookup.ambiguousSource: This URL is cited in more than one reference group. Choose the citation to reuse from the source list.
lookup.duplicateWarning: Saving creates a new source. The original source will not change.
lookup.replaceWarning: Saving replaces the original reference with this citation template.
lookup.metadataUnavailable: Source details could not be loaded: {error}
tools.advancedDescription: Choose changes to apply to all citations in the article.
tools.blockCitations: Place citation templates on separate lines with a two-space indent
tools.scriptTitleNonLatin: Use script-title only for languages written in non-Latin scripts
tools.scriptTitleAllForeign: Use script-title for every foreign language
tools.checksDescription: Each check opens its results in a separate dialog.
draft.originalDescription: This wikitext is shown for comparison. Saving replaces it with the citation template.
draft.originalValueDescription: Correct the original citation text if needed.
draft.nameValueHelp: This text is used in the generated reference name.
draft.nameAliasHelp: This text is used in the generated reference name.
draft.aliasDialogDescription: Enter the text to use in the generated reference name. For a URL, you can enter a shared source key. Leave blank to keep the original text.
draft.directivesDescription: Exclude this field from selected generated reference-name components.
draft.noDateDirective: Do not use this field for the year
draft.noAuthorDirective: Do not use this field for the author
draft.noPartDirective: Do not use this field for the part locator
draft.parameterAliasOf: {parameter} is another name for {canonical}. Other accepted names: {aliases}.
draft.switchStatus: Change status: live, dead, or unfit
draft.switchStatusLabel: Change URL status: live, dead, or unfit
draft.openUrl: Open URL in a new tab
draft.checkLinkLabel: Check and update the {parameter} article link
draft.splitAuthor: Use separate first and last name fields
draft.splitAuthorLabel: Use separate first and last fields for {parameter}
draft.invalidSummary: Correct the highlighted fields before saving.
draft.emptyCitation: Enter at least one citation field.
draft.missingParameterName: Enter a name for each populated parameter.
draft.aliasNeedsValue: Enter the original {parameter} text before setting its reference name.
draft.parameterCollisionNotice: Repeated or equivalent parameters: {parameters}. The first value stays active; later values receive -a, -b, … suffixes so CS1 flags them.
draft.previewUnavailable: Citation preview could not be loaded: {error}
feedback.referencesSkippedOne: skipped {count} reference not in a supported standard {{Cite …}} format
feedback.referencesSkippedMany: skipped {count} references not in a supported standard {{Cite …}} format
feedback.parameterCollisionsOne: marked {count} repeated parameter with an invalid suffix for CS1 review
feedback.parameterCollisionsMany: marked {count} repeated parameters with invalid suffixes for CS1 review
feedback.formatNoChanges: No citation formatting changes were made.
feedback.archiveCheckFailed: The archive date could not be checked. Check it manually.
feedback.linkCheckFailed: The article link could not be checked. Check it manually.
feedback.cancelUnavailable: Changes made by Citation formatter cannot be canceled because the article changed elsewhere.
feedback.sourceAppliedNoChanges: Citation source applied; no article text changed.
feedback.sourceAppliedReordered: Citation source applied; parameters were reordered.
feedback.newSourceCs1IssueOne: CS1 found 1 issue. Correct it before saving.
feedback.newSourceCs1IssueMany: CS1 found {count} issues. Correct them before saving.
analysis.title: Citation name consistency
analysis.intro: Review possible differences in website, publisher, author, reference-name, and source-key text. Choose the text to keep and the citations to update. Parameter names will not change.
analysis.revertUnavailable: This change cannot be reverted because its source changed.
analysis.undoUnavailable: These changes can no longer be undone because the article changed afterward.
analysis.closeConfirmationBody: This session includes applied citation consistency changes. Choose whether to undo or keep them, or continue editing.
analysis.selectOne: Select at least one citation to change.
analysis.sameDisplayStyle: Only link, case, spacing, or wikitext style differs.
analysis.sameHostValue: Citations for the same website use different names.
analysis.authorReason: The same author name uses different wikitext, link, case, or spacing style.
analysis.someMissingSourceKey: Some repeated uses have a source key and others do not.
analysis.differentSourceKey: Repeated uses have different source-key comments.
analysis.someMissingAlias: Some repeated uses have reference-name text and others do not.
analysis.differentAlias: Repeated uses have different reference-name text.
analysis.sourceMissing: A selected citation source is no longer present. Run the check again.
analysis.replacementConflict: One citation field has more than one replacement. Review the selections and apply them again.
analysis.sourceChanged: A citation source changed after the check opened. Run the check again.
analysis.fieldChanged: A selected citation field changed after the check opened. Run the check again.
checker.cs1Description: Checks citations against the CS1 rules currently used on {wiki} Wikipedia.
checker.unavailable: The CS1 check is temporarily unavailable. Run it again later.
checker.nonCs1Description: Finds references that do not use a supported CS1 citation template.
validation.invalidParameterName: Enter a parameter name without wikitext markup or line breaks.
validation.unsupportedParameter: CS1 does not support the {parameter} parameter.
validation.aliasRequiresValue: Enter the original text before setting reference-name text.
validation.archiveUrlRequiresDate: Add a date for the archive URL.
validation.archiveDateRequiresUrl: Add an archive URL for the archive date.
errors.sourceChanged: The source changed after it was opened. Open it again to continue.
tool.editorScope: Changes update the editor. Publish them with the wiki’s save action.
draft.parametersDescription: Edit the citation fields below. Highlighted fields contribute to its reference name.
